Abstract.AbstractText: Unprecedented scattered plots of calculated vs. measured 2,3JCHs in six densely oxygen-functionalized epoxides were found with some B3LYP protocols, an effect attributed to stereoelectronic effects in play. Hence, 27 other exchange-correlation density functionals (xc DFs) were benchmarked in this work. Very good results were achieved with mPW1PW91 and PBE0 used in conjunction with the pcJ-1 basis set (BS) of moderate size. A statistical analysis of 53 relationships between the predicted and observed 2,3JCH sets is presented. The effects of some xc DFs, including their x and c parts, and BSs on the calculation results are discussed, also in the context of DF modeling of electron density distribution. Moreover, related 1JCH sets predicted with 11 different DFT methods are considered and compared with the experimental data. Finally, some proposals for further improvement of existing DFs based on the available nJCH (n = 13) values are briefly outlined, being in line with recent results on the DFT electron densities (Medvedev et al., Science 2017, 355, 4952).
